chapter: Rhythm Club, studio dates and the 1930s big bands
title: Head arrangements in the studio, never any music
summary: McRae insists he never saw sheet music on these dates; the players worked out introductions and backgrounds on the spot.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
